title: A user with access to only one location still sees the Location filter with a single selectable location
custom_preconds:
1. A test user exists with access to exactly one location (create a fresh ZZAUTOTEST staff member if needed; clean up afterward).
2. You are signed in as that user on a desktop browser.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Inventory Value report.
2. Open the Location filter and read its options.
custom_expected:
1. The Location filter is still shown.
2. It offers the single location the user can access.
